## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/automateyournetwork/netclaw/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and used a numbered spec before implementation.
- [ ] Spec, research, plan, tasks and verification describe the final PR scope; any required maintainer scope review is complete.
- [ ] Specification artifact and declaration reconciliation checks pass.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; live, browser, Docker and host coverage gaps are stated explicitly.
- [ ] Applicable integration, installer, HUD and documentation surfaces are updated (or non-applicability explained).
- [ ] Completed-spec version bump, changelog and release notes are included or an explicit coordinated release plan is linked.
- [ ] No credentials, private network configuration or customer topology are included.
- [ ] Compatibility/migration and any operational approval requirements are documented.
